claim_text: SAE features cover substantially more Swiss-Prot functional concepts than raw neurons from the same protein language model (alignment gap).
judgment_rationale: The variant (ESM-2-8M, 6 layers, d_model=320) replicates the main experiment's conclusion exactly. SAE covered=14 vs main=15 (delta=-1, within sampling noise); neurons covered=0 in both. The direction SAE≫neurons is preserved across the model scale swap. The claim remains not-supported at the absolute threshold (14 < 65), consistent with main. No direction reversal. Verdict: PASS (robustness confirmed).
